hints.title: Character Count Invariant
hints.text: A k-subsequence consists of exactly k distinct characters selected from s.

hints.title: Greedy Frequency Selection
hints.text: To maximize the sum of frequencies (beauty), select characters with the highest frequencies first.

hints.title: Combinations on Ties
hints.text: When the threshold frequency has more candidates than needed, use combinations nCr to pick the required count, multiplying by freq^count.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def countKSubsequencesWithMaxBeauty(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        mod = 10**9 + 7
        cnt = Counter(s)
        if len(cnt) < k:
            return 0
        freqs = sorted(cnt.values(), reverse=True)
        cutoff = freqs[k - 1]
        ans = 1
        strictly_greater = 0
        for f in freqs:
            if f > cutoff:
                ans = (ans * f) % mod
                strictly_greater += 1
        needed = k - strictly_greater
        total_cutoff = freqs.count(cutoff)
        ways = math.comb(total_cutoff, needed) % mod
        ans = (ans * ways) % mod
        ans = (ans * pow(cutoff, needed, mod)) % mod
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is bounded by 26 characters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for 26 character frequencies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Count frequencies, sort greedily, and handle ties with modular combinations.
